name: eve-example-factory
description: The eve software factory restructured as a workspace of peer agents composed with defineLocalAgent (proposed).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:artifacts && pnpm run build:foreman
scripts.build:foreman: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; cd agents/foreman && eve build --skip-sandbox-prewarm
scripts.dev:foreman: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; cd agents/foreman && eve dev
scripts.eval:classifier: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; cd agents/classifier && eve eval
scripts.eval:foreman: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; cd agents/foreman && eve eval
